note: Expanded instrumentation commit on a local pilot branch; not pushed. Laws were frozen before triggerability analysis.

sanitizers.precondition: Equal-length finite floating N/E arrays, back-azimuth in [0,360], and bounded dynamic range.
sanitizers.invariant: N/E to R/T and back through rotate_rt_ne recovers both components.
sanitizers.alarm: Condition-aware round-trip error exceeds a float64 operation bound.
sanitizers.rationale: A failed inverse changes inferred radial and transverse motion.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-ROT-001 domain with squared norms representable in float64.
sanitizers.invariant: An orthonormal N/E to R/T basis change preserves per-sample squared norm.
sanitizers.alarm: R/T and N/E squared norms differ beyond accumulated float64 error.
sanitizers.rationale: Coordinate rotation cannot create or destroy ground-motion amplitude.

sanitizers.precondition: Equal-length finite Z/N/E arrays, angles in [0,360], and bounded dynamic range.
sanitizers.invariant: ZNE to LQT and back through rotate_lqt_zne recovers all components.
sanitizers.alarm: Any reconstructed component exceeds its float64 operation bound.
sanitizers.rationale: Ray-coordinate polarization requires a faithful basis transformation.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-ROT-003 domain with squared norms representable in float64.
sanitizers.invariant: The orthonormal ZNE/LQT transform preserves per-sample squared norm.
sanitizers.alarm: ZNE and LQT squared norms differ beyond accumulated float64 error.
sanitizers.rationale: A coordinate transform cannot change physical ground-motion amplitude.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite equal-length channels and a nonsingular orientation matrix with condition number <=1e8.
sanitizers.invariant: Sensor components to ZNE and back to the same sensor basis recovers all records.
sanitizers.alarm: Round-trip error exceeds eps times orientation condition and signal scale.
sanitizers.rationale: SEED orientation metadata must define a reversible physical basis.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-ROT-005 domain.
sanitizers.invariant: Jointly permuting channel data and their orientation metadata leaves ZNE unchanged.
sanitizers.alarm: A permuted public-API call differs beyond the conditioning-aware bound.
sanitizers.rationale: Station channel ordering has no physical meaning when metadata follows it.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite nondegenerate array geometry, positive vp>vs, positive noise, and normal-matrix condition <=1e7.
sanitizers.invariant: Joint station permutation preserves recovered strain and rotation time series.
sanitizers.observation_point: After the result dictionary is assembled.
sanitizers.alarm: Permuted-call physical outputs exceed a least-squares conditioning bound.
sanitizers.rationale: Station labels cannot affect inferred Earth strain or rotation.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-ARR-001 domain and translation rounding small relative to array aperture.
sanitizers.invariant: A common translation of all station coordinates leaves strain and rotation unchanged.
sanitizers.observation_point: After the result dictionary is assembled.
sanitizers.alarm: Translated-call outputs exceed coordinate-cancellation and least-squares error.
sanitizers.rationale: Spatial gradients depend on station separation, not coordinate origin.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-ARR-001 domain and finite representable common motion.
sanitizers.invariant: Adding identical three-component motion at every station leaves strain and rotation unchanged.
sanitizers.observation_point: After the result dictionary is assembled.
sanitizers.alarm: Common-mode transformed outputs exceed differencing and solve error.
sanitizers.rationale: Rigid translation of the full array has no spatial gradient.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite symmetric moment tensor and finite nonzero observation vectors.
sanitizers.invariant: P-wave far-field displacement is parallel to the radial direction.
sanitizers.alarm: The transverse displacement residual exceeds tensor-contraction error.
sanitizers.rationale: P-wave radiation is longitudinal.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite symmetric moment tensor and finite nonzero observation vectors.
sanitizers.invariant: S-wave far-field displacement is orthogonal to the radial direction.
sanitizers.alarm: The radial projection exceeds tensor-contraction error.
sanitizers.rationale: S-wave radiation is transverse.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite angular directions and moment tensor with representable trigonometric conversion.
sanitizers.invariant: Angular and Cartesian representations of the same directions yield the same displacement.
sanitizers.observation_point: After a farfield call with angular input.
sanitizers.alarm: Cartesian public-API re-call differs beyond conversion and contraction error.
sanitizers.rationale: Radiation cannot depend on a supported direction representation.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite moment tensor and finite nonzero Cartesian directions.
sanitizers.invariant: Radiation at an antipodal direction is the negative of the original displacement.
sanitizers.alarm: farfield(M,-p)+farfield(M,p) exceeds tensor-contraction error.
sanitizers.rationale: Moment-tensor far-field displacement has odd antipodal parity.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite tensor and directions; exact signed-permutation orthogonal transform.
sanitizers.invariant: Rotating tensor and directions rotates, but otherwise preserves, displacement.
sanitizers.alarm: The transformed re-call disagrees with the rotated original result.
sanitizers.rationale: A radiation pattern is independent of arbitrary Cartesian axis labels.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite nondegenerate ZNE covariance, >=3 selected samples, and threshold scaled with amplitude squared.
sanitizers.invariant: Uniform amplitude/unit scaling preserves all polarization attributes.
sanitizers.alarm: Scaled public-API call changes azimuth, incidence, rectilinearity, or planarity beyond eigensolver error.
sanitizers.rationale: Polarization geometry is independent of amplitude units.

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: polarization direction in a horizontal frame
sanitizers.precondition: OB-POL-001 domain with separated covariance eigenvalues.
sanitizers.invariant: An exact 90-degree N/E frame rotation shifts azimuth modulo 180 and preserves other attributes.
sanitizers.alarm: The rotated-frame public-API call violates angular covariance or scalar invariance.
sanitizers.rationale: Polarization must covary with the geographic coordinate frame.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-POL-001 domain with separated covariance eigenvalues.
sanitizers.invariant: Reversing all component polarities preserves canonical polarization attributes.
sanitizers.alarm: The polarity-reversed public-API call changes the canonicalized output.
sanitizers.rationale: Covariance polarization identifies an axis rather than an arrow.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite equal-shaped component windows, positive normf, and representable covariance.
sanitizers.invariant: An exact signed permutation of component axes preserves eigenvalues and dimensionless polarization measures.
sanitizers.alarm: The transformed public-API output differs beyond covariance/SVD error.
sanitizers.rationale: Polarization eigenvalues are coordinate invariants.

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: polarization covariance and shape under unit scaling
sanitizers.precondition: OB-POL-004 domain and bounded positive scale factor.
sanitizers.invariant: Scaling components by c scales eigenvalue quantities by c^2 and preserves rectilinearity/planarity.
sanitizers.alarm: The scaled-call covariance or dimensionless relations exceed numerical error.
sanitizers.rationale: Changing displacement units cannot change dimensionless polarization shape.

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: seismic arrival branch time and ray parameter
sanitizers.precondition: Valid model depths, distance, explicit phase list, and finite returned branches.
sanitizers.invariant: Travel-time and ray-path APIs return the same branches, times, and ray parameters.
sanitizers.alarm: A branch cannot be matched or differs beyond requested ray interpolation tolerance.
sanitizers.rationale: Path and scalar products represent the same seismic rays.

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: seismic arrival branch and discontinuity crossings
sanitizers.precondition: OB-TAUP-001 domain.
sanitizers.invariant: Travel-time and pierce-point APIs return the same branches, times, and ray parameters.
sanitizers.alarm: Branch matching or values differ beyond requested interpolation tolerance.
sanitizers.rationale: Adding discontinuity crossings must not alter the underlying ray solution.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite nonempty, non-resampled path and finite arrival metadata.
sanitizers.invariant: Final path time and angular distance agree with arrival time and purist distance.
sanitizers.alarm: Endpoint disagreement exceeds 256 times requested ray-parameter refinement or float error.
sanitizers.rationale: A ray path must terminate at its reported receiver in time and angle.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite float64 trace, nlta>nsta>0, sufficient samples, and representable energy.
sanitizers.invariant: Independent C and Python implementations agree within cumulative-sum error.
sanitizers.alarm: Python result differs beyond eps times trace length and output scale.
sanitizers.rationale: Implementation choice must not change seismic onset strength.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite float64 trace, nlta>nsta>0, sufficient samples, and representable recurrence.
sanitizers.invariant: Independent C and Python recursive implementations agree within accumulation error.
sanitizers.alarm: Python result differs beyond a length- and scale-aware recurrence bound.
sanitizers.rationale: Implementation choice must not change seismic onset strength.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite stable conjugate PAZ, positive sampling interval/FFT length, and well-conditioned sampled response.
sanitizers.invariant: Vectorized SciPy response amplitudes agree with ObsPy's scalar PAZ evaluator at sampled FFT frequencies.
sanitizers.alarm: Any of up to 33 sampled bins disagrees beyond polynomial/product evaluation error.
sanitizers.rationale: Instrument correction requires a consistent transfer function across independent paths.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite trace; identical remove/simulate PAZ; symmetric sensitivity; no taper, detrend or prefilter; discarded spectral bins contain no signal.
sanitizers.invariant: Removing and immediately simulating the same instrument recovers the input trace.
sanitizers.alarm: Round-trip error exceeds FFT-length and response-conditioning error.
sanitizers.rationale: A response followed by its inverse must preserve represented ground motion.

sanitizers.precondition: Distinct finite geographic points, valid positive ellipsoid, and a solved non-antipodal geodesic.
sanitizers.invariant: Exchanging endpoints preserves geodesic distance.
sanitizers.observation_point: After the inverse geodesic solution returns.
sanitizers.alarm: Reverse-direction distance differs beyond an ellipsoid-scale float bound.
sanitizers.rationale: Physical surface distance is independent of travel direction.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-GEO-001 domain with distinct endpoints.
sanitizers.invariant: Exchanging endpoints exchanges forward and back azimuths modulo 360 degrees.
sanitizers.alarm: Either reciprocal bearing has excessive circular disagreement.
sanitizers.rationale: Reversing a geodesic exchanges its endpoint bearings.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-GEO-001 domain with moderate longitudes.
sanitizers.invariant: Adding a full turn to both longitudes preserves distance and bearings.
sanitizers.alarm: Distance or circular bearings differ beyond derived rounding error.
sanitizers.rationale: A geodesic cannot depend on longitude representation.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite broadcast-compatible geographic points with valid latitudes and moderate longitudes.
sanitizers.invariant: Exchanging endpoints preserves angular distance.
sanitizers.alarm: Reverse-direction result differs beyond trigonometric rounding error.
sanitizers.rationale: Spherical surface distance has no preferred direction.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-GEO-004 domain.
sanitizers.invariant: A common 90-degree longitude rotation preserves angular distance.
sanitizers.alarm: The distances differ beyond trigonometric rounding error.
sanitizers.rationale: Great-circle separation is independent of the prime meridian.

sanitizers.precondition: Solved finite non-antipodal points and a positive finite sphere radius.
sanitizers.invariant: A zero-flattening ellipsoid agrees with spherical angular distance using the same radius.
sanitizers.alarm: Metric and converted angular distances exceed combined model rounding error.
sanitizers.rationale: A zero-flattening ellipsoid is physically the same sphere.

sanitizers.precondition: Finite nonempty longitudes in [-180,180] with nondegenerate circular resultant.
sanitizers.invariant: A common longitude rotation rotates the circular mean modulo 360 degrees.
sanitizers.observation_point: After the circular mean is returned.
sanitizers.alarm: Shifted mean disagrees with the rotated original beyond sample-conditioned error.
sanitizers.rationale: Mean direction must covary with the longitude reference frame.

sanitizers.precondition: Equal-length finite floating waveforms, valid shift, and nonzero energy when normalized.
sanitizers.invariant: Exchanging waveforms reverses the lag axis.
sanitizers.alarm: Exchanged correlation differs from the reversed result beyond accumulation error.
sanitizers.rationale: Inferred delay changes sign when waveform roles exchange.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-XCORR-001 domain with naive normalization and bounded positive rescaling.
sanitizers.invariant: Positive waveform gain changes do not alter normalized correlation.
sanitizers.alarm: Normalized coefficients differ beyond norm and dot-product rounding error.
sanitizers.rationale: Normalized waveform similarity measures shape, not sensor gain.

sanitizers.precondition: OB-XCORR-001 domain with real floating waveforms and meaningful energy.
sanitizers.invariant: Direct summation and FFT convolution return the same normalized correlation.
sanitizers.observation_point: Results from both supported numerical methods.
sanitizers.alarm: The algorithms disagree beyond their combined length-scaled error.
sanitizers.rationale: Waveform similarity and delay cannot depend on the numerical backend.
